header.title: How to Make Your Own SAD Light Box
header.description: This guide provides instructions on building a simple Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) light box using readily available materials. Follow these steps to construct a DIY light box that can help combat the effects of winter blues.

steps.description: Determine the placement of bulbs within a box, aiming for approximately 10 lights, by measuring lamp bases and marking the box.
actions: Figure out where you want to place the bulbs inside of a box.
Measure the circumference of one of the lamp bases.
Create small cutouts.
Lay the cutouts on the outside bottom of the box.
Mark the cutouts with a pencil.
Leave a little bit of space around each light.

steps.description: Drill holes in the box using a hole saw bit after determining the layout.
actions: Clamp down the box to a sturdy table
Drill the holes
Double check that the lamps fit inside the hole

steps.description: Apply reflective material (aluminum foil or mirrors) to the inside of the box and cut out holes.
actions: Apply aluminum foil around all sides and bottom of the box
Secure the aluminum foil in place with glue
Wait for the glue to dry
Cut out the holes in the aluminum foil

steps.description: Secure the lamps to the box with silicone, manage cables, and connect the bulbs in parallel.
actions: Secure the lamps to the back of the box with silicone.
Ensure the epoxy is non-shrinking.
Wait for the glue to dry.
Tidy up the cables with organizers.
Connect the bulbs in parallel.

steps.description: Inspect the assembled box for imperfections, test its functionality for 30 minutes, and ensure it doesn't overheat.
actions: Inspect the box for imperfections
Inspect the box for exposed wires
Plug the unit in
Test the unit for 30 minutes
Monitor the box for excessive heat

steps.description: Complete the project by concealing cables and optionally staining the box.
actions: Attach the top of the box on the rear.
Ensure enough space for the main cable to get through.
Stain the box to your liking (optional).
Leave the box in its original color (optional).
